# Judo Misc P2 Site

> An Eclipse P2 update site that repackages Maven Central artifacts as OSGi bundles, allowing Eclipse-based JUDO tooling to consume third-party libraries through the standard update-site mechanism.

Key facts:
- Java 17, Maven 3.9.4 (via `./mvnw` wrapper), POM-only packaging (no Java source code)
- Uses p2-maven-plugin 2.0.0 to convert Maven artifacts into OSGi bundles and generate P2 repository metadata
- Currently bundles Apache Commons Text 1.9 (with transitive dependencies) as a P2 feature
- Output is a distributable ZIP containing a self-contained P2 repository
- Part of the [judo-community](https://github.com/BlackBeltTechnology/judo-community) aggregator ecosystem
- License: Eclipse Public License 2.0 (EPL-2.0)

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): Project overview, build commands, usage instructions, and architecture diagrams
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Developer guide with directory structure, build commands, Maven profiles, and how to add dependencies
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): Contribution guidelines
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): Release history

## Build Inputs

- [pom.xml](pom.xml): Main build file — artifact declarations, feature definitions, plugin configuration, and deployment profiles
- [category.xml](category.xml): P2 category definitions mapping features to categories displayed in Eclipse
- [src/assembly/assembly.xml](src/assembly/assembly.xml): Maven assembly descriptor packaging the P2 repository directory into a ZIP

## CI/CD

- [.github/CIFLOW.md](.github/CIFLOW.md): CI/CD workflow documentation and branching strategy (GitFlow)
- [.github/workflows/build.yml](.github/workflows/build.yml): Main CI pipeline — builds, deploys, tags, and creates GitHub releases
- [.github/workflows/release.yml](.github/workflows/release.yml): Manual release trigger — creates PRs to master and bumps develop version

- [LICENSE.txt](LICENSE.txt): EPL-2.0 license text

- [.github/workflows/create-release-tagged.yml](.github/workflows/create-release-tagged.yml): Tagged release creation
